prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular game-sprite garment source board for Realm's deterministic offline 2D skeletal compiler
Primary request: Create a NEW lumberjack/woodsman workwear component board that fits the woodsman identity in Image 2 while matching the exact modular board structure, painted resolution, polish, and clothing-part conventions of Images 1 and 3. This is a source-parts board, not an assembled character and not an animation.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact work-garment layout and part-coverage reference. Image 2 is the new woodsman body/identity and fit reference. Image 3 is a second established Realm garment rendering reference. Preserve their classic strategy-game language while creating a distinct lumber role costume.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for local removal.
Subject garment: practical medieval frontier forestry workwear: close-fitting dark forest-green wool cap; moss-green heavy wool overshirt with rolled sleeves; deep rust-brown split-leather protective apron/chest panel with two narrow shoulder straps and reinforced edge stitching; broad dark leather belt with a small iron buckle; rugged dark umber work trousers with subtle reinforced knees; weathered high brown leather logging boots. No axe or tool on this board.
Style/medium: crisp hand-painted classic 1990s strategy-game sprite source art, controlled pixel-cluster-friendly edges, strong readable material separation, warm highlights, dark outline clusters, no photorealism, no blur, no dither, no soft ambient shadow.
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape. Match Image 1's modular garment-board layout exactly: top row has isolated cap front, cap back, cap left-profile; middle row has isolated left sleeve, front tunic/apron, back tunic/straps, left-profile tunic/apron, isolated right sleeve; next row has isolated front, back, and side belt pieces; bottom row has separated trouser/boot components providing front, back, left-profile, and right-profile coverage. Every part upright, fully uncropped, separated by generous uniform gaps, and sized/placed like Image 1. No assembled full character anywhere.
Lighting/mood: fixed upper-left warm key light identical across every component and view.
Color palette: moss and dark forest green wool, deep rust/umber leather, aged iron buckle, warm brown boots; do not use magenta or bright pink anywhere in the garment.
Materials/textures: coarse wool, scuffed split leather, restrained stitching and repaired seams that remain legible at sprite scale.
Constraints: exact same garment construction, colors, strap placement, cap, apron length, belt, trousers, and boots across front/back/profile parts; anatomically compatible joint endpoints matching Image 2; clean shoulder, elbow, waist, hip, knee, and ankle cut zones; each component isolated; one consistent scale; background one uniform #ff00ff with no shadows, gradients, texture, floor, lighting variation, border, labels, or guides; no body parts except tiny necessary neck/limb openings; no text; no watermark.
Avoid: assembled character, multiple outfits, duplicate extra hats, yellow farm apron, blue guard uniform, fantasy armor, fur cape, axe, weapons, tools, props, scenery, perspective views, changing garment identity, green/magenta fringe, cast shadow, contact shadow.
